title: Security & Privacy
appLockSubtitle: CircuSave locks as soon as you leave the app. Unlock with fingerprint, Face ID, or your CircuSave password. This stays on.
biometricAssurance: Your CircuSave password still unlocks the app. CircuSave does not read or store your fingerprint or face.
biometricSettingsErrorBody: CircuSave could not open the device security settings.
changePasswordBody: To change your password, sign out and select “Forgot Password” on the login screen. You will be sent a secure recovery code via email.
exportDataBody: Download a complete JSON archive of your profile, circle participation, legal acceptances, and records.
exportErrorBody: Unable to export user data. Please check your connection.
deleteAccountBody: Anonymize your personal information and delete your account in accordance with App Store & Google Play privacy policies.
deleteConfirmBody:
Are you sure you want to permanently delete your account?

• Your personal details (name, email, phone) will be anonymized.
• Your active session will be revoked immediately.
• Required financial transaction records will be retained for regulatory audit compliance.
deletedBody: Your account has been deleted and anonymized.
deleteErrorBody: Unable to complete account deletion. Please verify your connection or try again.
